title: Chagent evaluation case
description: One case is one task, its authority, its budget and the conditions that decide whether it passed. It contains no result: a case is a question, a trial is an answer.

id.description: Stable identifier. Renaming it creates a new case; changing the task under the same id requires a version bump.

version.description: Bumped whenever the task, fixture, authority or graders change. Results from two versions are not comparable.

capability.description: Capability under test, taken from the coverage table in the plan. A case reports on exactly one.

prompt.description: The user turn the agent receives, verbatim.

path.description: Repository-relative path to the fixture source.

sha256.description: Content hash of the packed fixture. Required for anything restored from an archive.

authority.description: The execution axes this case is allowed to run under. A trial that ran under different axes is not this case.

approvals.description: Expected approval decisions, in order. A recorded decision is evidence, never a reusable grant.

kind.description: Deterministic first. A model rubric is a supplement calibrated against human labels, never the sole gate.

expects.description: The condition, in a form the grader can decide.

evidence.description: Where the deciding fact comes from: files, HTTP, database, approval records or report text.

cleanup.description: How the fixture and any started service are torn down. An unverified cleanup makes the next trial's baseline unknown.
